verdict.rationale: Folk documents a public REST API with JSON resources, bearer-token API-key auth, header-based versioning with a deprecation policy, IETF rate-limit headers, batch endpoints, and CRUD endpoints for people and custom objects, plus a quick-start guide. Probes confirm the developer docs and an llms.txt index are live. API access appears in the pricing list for a higher tier, alongside custom objects and dashboards. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of using the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
